title: 第一卷 第11章 赵济第一卷 第12章 天黑了
lines: 罗望淡笑道：“二位也不必感到委屈，罗某这可是为了你们好。这秦绝若是真的动手，必然会先拿弱一点的家族开刀立威。
你们左右是要还的，不如主动示弱，先将地契送过去，如此既稳住了秦绝，又可以保全你们两家实力不受折损。
在此，罗某也可向二位保证，只要秦绝一死，你们交出去的产业，将来还会再回到你们手中。”
李照丰、安成锐二人想想也是，虽然这样做，会丢点面子，但总比被秦绝灭了好啊。
李照丰抱拳笑道：“罗家主所言有理，既如此，一会我便将地契送去秦府。”
安成锐亦是说道：“安家也会将地契送过去。”
罗望哈哈一笑：“好。但此间之事，二位还要保密才是。”
“那是一定！”李照丰、安成锐连忙应道。
罗望又看向三大家族的家主，淡笑道：“倘若这秦绝拿了李家、安家的地契还不知足，明日向我们四家发难，那便需要我们四家联合起来，与之对抗。在此，罗某希望三位能够表个态，是否愿意与罗某结成同盟？”
韩风、王圣眼眸微闪，陷入思索。
而一直没有说话的赵家家主赵济，却在此刻面带着微笑，站了起来。
这赵济，身着一件青色儒衫，短须白面，看上去颇为儒雅。
“今日的结盟，我赵家就不参与了，来此之前，赵某已经决定，将地契归还。而且这秦绝所求，并不过分，他只是要回他们秦家的产业而已，又不是谋求我等家族的产业，诸位何必费这些心思呢？”赵济淡笑道。
罗望脸色一沉，皱眉冷声道：“这吃进嘴的肥肉，怎可再还回去！再说了，这五年来，我们在这些产业上，那也是倾注了不少精力的，凭什么那小子一句话，我们就要还回去！赵家主若真是怕了，直说便是，又何必在我等面前故作清高？”
罗望也没想到，四大家族之中，竟有两个怂蛋。
可如果王家和赵家都不结盟，单凭他罗家和韩家，想对抗秦绝，可就不容易了。
赵济淡笑道：“罗家主就只当是我赵某怕了吧。赵某便先告辞了。”
赵济拱了拱手，竟是直接要走了。
蹭！
罗望怒然站起，寒声道：“赵济，你可别怪罗某没有劝过你，今日你若不结盟，他日秦绝死后，你交出去的那些产业，可就别想着还能轻易拿回去了！”
赵济微笑道：“真有那时，各位请便。”
罗望气的鼻孔都被呼出的粗气给撑大了。
“呵，好！记住你说过的话！”罗望怒笑道。
赵济笑了笑，微微抬手抱拳，随即转身离去。
罗望一脸阴沉，看向王圣和韩风，道：“二位，树活一张皮，人活一张脸！这赵济不在乎脸面，我们可不能学他一般！倘若我们乖乖将地契还了回去，往后我等威严何存？只怕我们手底下的人，都会在暗地里笑话我们这些家主，都是软蛋！”
王圣脸色尴尬，道：“可如今少了一个赵家，仅凭我们三家之力，还能对抗得了秦绝吗？”
罗望冷笑道：“就算那小子真的成了大宗师，我等三家三个大宗师，还怕敌不过他一个？王家主，切莫气短啊！想要吃肉，那就必须要当狼，而不能成为一条温顺的狗！”
王圣脸皮微抽，合着他不答应结盟，就成狗了？
韩风点头道：“罗家主所言在理。我韩家，愿意结盟！”
王圣想了想，一咬牙，道：“行，那王某也赌上一把！说实话，将那些产业就这么还回去，王某也觉得肉疼。”
“哈哈，这才是大族家主该有的模样！等秦绝一死，赵家还回去的那些产业，到时候就是我们三家的了！他赵济若敢争抢，我们就联手灭了赵家！”罗望笑着笑着，笑容变得有些狰狞。
王圣和韩风则是心头一震，这罗望的心思，果然歹毒，竟还想着灭了赵家。
content_en:
Luo Wang smiled lightly and said: "You two don't have to feel aggrieved, Luo is doing this for your own good. If Qin Jue really takes action, he will definitely attack the weaker family first to establish his power.
You guys have to pay back, so why not take the initiative to show weakness and send over the land deed first? This will not only stabilize Qin Jue, but also protect the strength of your two families from being compromised.
Here, Luo can also assure you that as long as Qin Jue dies, the property you handed over will return to your hands in the future. "
Li Zhaofeng and An Chengrui thought about it. Although they would lose some face by doing this, it was still better than being destroyed by Qin Jue.
Li Zhaofeng clasped his fists and said with a smile: "What the Luo Family Master said makes sense. In that case, I will send the land deed to the Qin Mansion soon."
An Chengrui also said: "The An family will also send the land deed."
Luo Wang laughed: "Okay. But you two have to keep this matter a secret."
"That's for sure!" Li Zhaofeng and An Chengrui responded quickly.
Luo Wang looked at the heads of the three major families again, and said with a smile: "If Qin Jue is not satisfied after taking the land deeds of the Li family and the An family, and attacks the four of us tomorrow, then the four of us will need to unite to fight against them. Here, Luo hopes that the three of them can express their stance. Are you willing to form an alliance with Luo?"
Han Feng and Wang Sheng's eyes flashed slightly, lost in thought.
But Zhao Ji, the head of the Zhao family who had been silent, stood up with a smile on his face at this moment.
This Zhao Ji, wearing a blue Confucian shirt, short beard and white face, looks quite elegant.
"My Zhao family will not participate in today's alliance. Before coming here, Zhao has already decided to return the land deed. Moreover, Qin Jue's request is not excessive. He just wants to return their Qin family's property, and he is not seeking our family's property. Why do you need to bother?" Zhao Ji said with a smile.
Luo Wang's face darkened, he frowned and said coldly: "How can we give back the fat that we have eaten in our mouths! Besides, in the past five years, we have put a lot of energy into these industries. Why should we give it back with just one word from that kid! If the Zhao family master is really afraid, just say so, why bother pretending to be noble in front of us?"
Luo Wang also didn't expect that there were two cowards among the four major families.
But if the Wang family and the Zhao family do not form an alliance, it will not be easy for the Luo family and the Han family alone to fight against Qin Jue.
Zhao Ji smiled lightly and said: "Master Luo, just think that I, Zhao, are afraid. Zhao will leave first."
Zhao Ji cupped his hands and was about to leave.
rub!
Luo Wang stood up angrily and said in a cold voice: "Zhao Ji, don't blame Luo for not persuading you. If you don't form an alliance today, don't think you can easily get back the properties you handed over after Qin Jue's death!"
Zhao Ji smiled and said: "If that happens, please excuse me."
Tao Wang's nostrils were dilated by the heavy breath he exhaled.
"Ha, okay! Remember what you said!" Luo Wang laughed angrily.
Zhao Ji smiled, raised his hands slightly and cupped his fists, then turned and left.
Luo Wang looked at Wang Sheng and Han Feng with a gloomy face, and said: "You two, a tree has a skin, and a man has a face! This Zhao Ji doesn't care about face, we can't imitate him! If we obediently return the land deed, how will our dignity remain in the future? I'm afraid that the people under us will secretly laugh at us, the family heads, for we are all weaklings!"
Wang Sheng looked embarrassed and said: "But now that there is one less Zhao family, can we still resist Qin Jue with the strength of the three of us?"
Luo Wang sneered and said: "Even if that kid really becomes a grand master, we and the three grand masters from the three families are still afraid that we can't defeat him? Master Wang, don't be short of breath! If you want to eat meat, you must be a wolf, not a docile dog!"
Wang Sheng's face twitched slightly. If he doesn't agree to form an alliance, will he become a dog?
Han Feng nodded and said: "What the Luo family leader said is reasonable. I, the Han family, are willing to form an alliance!"
Wang Sheng thought for a while, gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, then Wang will take a gamble! To be honest, Wang will feel a physical pain just to return those properties."
"Haha, this is what the head of a wealthy family should look like! When Qin Jue dies, the properties returned by the Zhao family will belong to our three families! If Zhao Ji dares to fight for it, we will join hands to destroy the Zhao family!" Luo Wang smiled, and his smile became a little ferocious.
Wang Sheng and Han Feng were shocked. Luo Wang's thoughts were indeed vicious, and he actually wanted to destroy the Zhao family.
